publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for web-app surface discovery routes.
Cross-feature factory for reading and triggering approved web-app discovery results.
Cross-feature seam for current approved discovery runs, surfaces, and structure nodes.
Exported API response types for discovery routes.
Exported discovered surface and structure data types for cross-feature planning and reconciliation.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing discovery structure or discovered-surface data semantics can break webAppHierarchyBuilder reconciliation and preview logic.
Changing approved discovery run behavior can break operator workflows that depend on stable discovery scope and output shape.
